name: qkd_sbufp_ref

job.purpose: q13b-kvend: ot_qkvd_sbufp through the reference tile flow, replacing the old-flow ot_qkvd_sbuf view (clock insertion 505 ps max / 280 min, SS -251 ps, unregistered ~660 ps pop cone) that made the kv_end spine diverge (qkd_d2d_ref-q10: L 2,509 ps, hold stall -169 on 2,139 inputs). pop registered once per slice inside the tile; every face pin registered; kv_end PQ=2 child.

benches.name: sbufp_d64
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012  -s tb_qkvd_buf_tile_p -P tb_qkvd_buf_tile_p.D=64 -o {RUN}/bench/sbufp_d64 rtl/test/qwen_kv_die/tb_qkvd_buf_tile_p.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_buf_tiles.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo_sl.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_d2d.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo_sb.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2.v && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/sbufp_d64 | tee {RUN}/bench/sbufp_d64.log && grep -q "^PASS" {RUN}/bench/sbufp_d64.log

job.structural_change: SRAM pin-edge M5 no-entry guard (macro_edge_via_guard, 1.2 um per vertical macro edge, added pre-GRT / removed post-DRT) + kit recipe 2 (macro halo 5.4 um, hold margin 30 ps, pin hold cells and pin flops FIRM at the pins): q14 routes kept 2-5 M4 shorts at the SRAM east pin edge and one missed FF by 24 ps
